description_en: Adds a callback configuration for audio moderation
description_zh: 添加音频审核回调信息
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-audio-audit-notify-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --callback https://demo.aliyundoc.com/callback --callback-template domain_:_DomainName_,_app_:_AppName_,_stream_:_StreamName_,_timestamp_:_Timestamp_,_result_:_Result --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveAudioAuditNotifyConfig

parameters.description_en: The URL used to receive callbacks for audio that contains problematic content.
parameters.description_zh: 回调地址。用于接收问题语音内容的回调。
parameters.help_en: The URL used to receive callbacks for audio that contains problematic content
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址。用于接收问题语音内容的回调
parameters.name: callback

parameters.description_en:
The callback template for automated reviews. The value is a JSON string that can contain the following variables:

- **{DomainName}**: The streaming domain.

- **{AppName}**: The AppName of the live stream.

- **{StreamName}**: The stream name.

- **{Timestamp}**: The UNIX timestamp of the callback. Unit: seconds.

- **{Result}**: The review result.
parameters.description_zh:
审核回调模板。取值：

- **{DomainName}**：播流域名。
- **{AppName}**：播流所属的应用名称。
- **{StreamName}**：播流名称。
- **{Timestamp}**：Unix时间戳，返回的回调时间。单位：秒。
- **{Result}**：检测结果。
